intro.text: A Dayside animal whose horns and carapace dissolve in water, so it never drinks and lives on large amounts of sand instead.
Sandlings tamed by Daysiders to carry loads.

description.text: Tonks walk on four legs. The head and front half are like a mule's, the hindquarters more like a kangaroo's. Grey, jointed carapace covers the body, thickest along the back, and they have long heavy tails, horns jutting from the head at odd angles, and clawed feet that seem to have opposable thumbs.

Tonks carry riders and goods across Dayside's deserts. They are dim and easily led, and calling someone a tonk is an insult. Darksiders visiting Dayside sometimes use them, though Khrissalla's party seems unfamiliar with their habits.

Riders use a saddle, bridle and saddlebags, and long trips may call for extra water vessels. Tonks are trained to turn or change pace when tapped on different parts of the shell with a riding mallet, helped by reins. When frightened or confused they bury themselves with only their horns showing, until a tap on the horns tells them it is safe; skilled riders like Aarik can stop them. Hunters prefer terhan, which are bigger and faster.
Tonks count as sandlings, sharing horns, carapace that water dissolves and a habit of burrowing with terhan and other kinds.
They always smell faintly of sulphur, their wind is especially foul, and their dung is called tonk guano.
